purpose: Resolve the two coarse H2 modes with fresh seeds: the attack-only ridge centered near useful_attack_reward=1, and the attack/cancellation interaction that appeared at (1.5,0.5). Extend the useful-attack boundary only along cancellation=0.5 because the coarse winner there sat at attack=1.5.

fixed_stack.authority: synchronous Tetrp TL with authority-validated reset-safe placement transport

design_reason: (1.0,0), (1.25,0), and (1.5,0) resolve the attack-only ridge without assuming the historical attack=1 point remains optimal.
(1.5,0), (1.5,0.25), and (1.5,0.5) form a fixed-attack cancellation cross to test whether the coarse (1.5,0.5) result reflects a reproducible interaction rather than small-sample noise.
(1.75,0.5) extends the only outward coarse boundary that was simultaneously among the best observed points.
No cancellation>0.5 point is included because cancellation=1 was weaker than cancellation=0.5 at attack=1.5 and weaker than cancellation=0 at lower attack values in the coarse sweep.

sampling.common_random_numbers: All six refined candidates use the same 40 fresh asymmetric seed pairs.
sampling.independence: Each asymmetric pair is one experimental unit.

integrity_gates: Every candidate must have exactly 40 complete asymmetric pairs / 80 scored games with no harness failures.
Each pair must contain the candidate once in slot0 and once in slot1.
The one-lock placement-transport guard must remain enabled.
No malformed or unscored game is converted into a loss.

preregistered_selection.eligibility: candidate_sweeps > incumbent_sweeps AND candidate KO wins > 40/80
preregistered_selection.ranking: Among eligible candidates rank first by net paired sweeps, then by candidate KO wins.
preregistered_selection.exact_tie: If multiple candidates tie on both primary and secondary ranking, do not pick between them from diagnostics; require a fresh paired decider.
preregistered_selection.outward_boundary: If (1.75,0.5) is the unique top-ranked eligible candidate, do not fix it as the finalist; extend the useful-attack boundary with fresh seeds first.
preregistered_selection.fixed_finalist: Otherwise the unique top-ranked eligible candidate becomes the fixed H2 finalist for a separate ~200-pair / 400-game fresh promotion confirmation.
preregistered_selection.no_eligible: If no candidate is eligible, H2 is not promoted and corrected_legacy_h12 remains incumbent.

note: This local refinement may select a fixed finalist but cannot promote H2. Promotion requires a later large fresh confirmation.

validity_scope.discovered_during_run: The run was launched before discovering that the authority/search stack used b2bcharge_base=0 while real TL replay evidence used b2bcharge_base=3.
validity_scope.disposition: Let the already-running job finish, but treat all outcomes as diagnostics only. The preregistered finalist-selection rule is suspended and this run cannot select or promote a real-TL H2 finalist.
